responsibility: Implements default-channel INTEGER and CARDINAL text I/O by forwarding to WholeIO using StdChans.StdInChan and StdChans.StdOutChan. Its responsibility is the ISO convenience binding to standard channels rather than the numeric scanning or formatting algorithms themselves.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the SWholeIO pair: it contains the forwarding bodies that invoke WholeIO on StdChans standard channels, whereas SWholeIO.def only defines the exported signatures and behavior.
